title: Profile
description: A calibrated parameter set with source Design/Scenario and measurement provenance; legacy profiles remain readable but are not assigned new physical mappings.

parameters.description: Physical mappings beest-physical-v1 target MuJoCo. Known parameter units are listed below; legacy names remain readable but cannot be applied without a verified mapping.

residual.description: fit error in the units of the compared quantity

x-doc.zh: 参数到主物理模型的映射版本。v2 修正质量归一化接触阻尼；旧版本和缺少声明的档案可读取，须重新校准后应用。
x-doc.en: Version of mappings into the main physics model. v2 corrects mass-normalised contact damping; older or unversioned profiles remain readable but require recalibration before application.

x-doc.zh: 校准时设计物理内容的哈希，防止同 ID 的已修改设计误用校准结果。
x-doc.en: Hash of the Design physical content at calibration, preventing application after same-ID physical edits.

x-doc.zh: 旧名字或旧 ID；指向它们的引用都解析到这个资产
x-doc.en: Former names or ids; a reference to any of them resolves to this asset

uncertainty.description: Per parameter: 95 % intervals from the posterior and from the profile likelihood, the share of the prior range the data cannot exclude, and whether the parameter is identifiable from this data

x-doc.zh: 校准使用的完整基准 Scenario；物理参数回写在此场景上进行。旧档案不补写。
x-doc.en: Full baseline Scenario used for calibration and subsequent parameter application; never backfilled for legacy profiles.

x-doc.zh: 稳定的资产 ID（ULID，26 个字符，按创建时间可排序）
x-doc.en: Stable asset id (ULID: 26 characters, sortable by creation time)
